mechanics.title: Waypoints
mechanics.description: Create, edit, hide, share in chat, group into sets and (with permission) teleport to waypoints; local vs. global waypoints with a max draw distance.

mechanics.title: Cave mode and radar
mechanics.description: Automatic cave mode when under a roof; entities shown as dots or icons; square or circle shape; lock-north option.

mechanics.title: Server controls and effects
mechanics.description: Servers can enforce a config profile and use the effects xaerominimap:no_minimap, no_entity_radar, no_waypoints and no_cave_maps to restrict features. Can also be bound to an item held in hotbar or equipped.

commands_and_keybinds: All keys can be rebound in Controls
editor_notes: Author warns against XaeroPlus. Bundles XaeroLib. Default U conflicts with Woodwalkers' unlock key.
name: Xaero's Minimap
summary: A vanilla-styled minimap in a screen corner showing terrain, mobs, players and items, with waypoints visible in the world. Includes cave mode and optional server-controlled limits.
